about: Waterloo is a city in Waterloo Region, immediately north of Kitchener in southwestern Ontario. It is known for the University of Waterloo, Wilfrid Laurier University, and a dense cluster of tech and insurance employers. Uptown Waterloo is a separate commercial core from downtown Kitchener, linked by ION light rail. About 120,000 people live in Waterloo.
seoSummary: University and tech city north of Kitchener, home to UW, Laurier, and Uptown.
